Type: table
Name: Strathwood Grand Isle 48-Inch Round Dining Table with Umbrella Hole
Materials: Aluminum
Attractive outdoor dining table with umbrella hole makes for easy and fun entertaining in all weather Frame is durable yet lightweight cast aluminum with a black powder-coated finish; solid look and feel, with lightness for maneuverability 4 contoured legs give plenty of knee space all around; slat design allows for great ventilation Coordinating arm chairs available; use alone or as part of a matching outdoor furniture collection Measures 29.1 inches high with a 48-inch diameter; weighs 42 pounds
